title: Degree-zero injective abelian hypercover section exactness
statement: the restriction map from X to U_0 is injective and its image is exactly the degree-zero cycles

proof.text: Apply Hom into the injective sheaf I to the degree-zero free abelian component. The free-presheaf Yoneda identification turns Hom into sections, and injectivity makes the resulting augmented short complex exact; its kernel is exactly the range of restriction from X.

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_injective_abelian_zero
    {X : Scheme.{w}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : SplitEtaleHypercover X)
    (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}) [Injective I] :
    Function.Injective (I.obj.map (terminal.from
          (U.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)))).op) ∧
      (∀ s : I.obj.obj (op (U.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)))),
        ((AlgebraicTopology.alternatingCofaceMapComplex AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}).obj
          (U.simplicial.rightOp ⋙ I.obj)).d 0 1 s = 0 ↔
          s ∈ Set.range (I.obj.map (terminal.from
          (U.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)))).op))
